title: Understanding the pentafluorosulfanyl group and property-driven design of SF5-containing compounds
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,1333-1351
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00566C, Tutorial Review
Thi Mo Nguyen, Floriane René, Vincent Bizet, Dominique Cahard
This tutorial review explores the structure, properties, and reactivity of the SF5 group, highlighting its unique characteristics and its growing importance in modern synthetic chemistry, materials development, and molecular design applications.
